panel.title: NETRADAR TELEMETRY
panel.diag_optimal: Wi-Fi link and game routing are pristine.
panel.diag_wifi_issue: High jitter/latency to local router. Possible Wi-Fi congestion (2.4 GHz) or distance.
panel.diag_isp_issue: Local router is fast, but ISP or external game routing has high packet loss/latency.
panel.diag_captive_portal: Connected to local router, but internet is blocked. Check captive login.
panel.diag_no_internet: Connected to local router, but no internet access.
panel.diag_offline: No default gateway found. Network is disconnected.
panel.diag_wired_optimal: Ethernet wired connection is pristine and stable.
panel.diag_weak_signal_stable: Wi-Fi signal is moderate ({signal}%), but link and game routing remain stable.
panel.diag_isp_loss: ISP or external internet connection experiencing packet loss ({loss}%).
panel.diag_isp_lag: Local router is fast, but ISP internet routing latency is high ({ms}ms).
panel.diag_server_loss: Internet is healthy, but target game server is experiencing packet loss ({loss}%).
panel.diag_server_lag: Internet is fast, but target game server latency is high ({ms}ms).
panel.diag_local_bufferbloat: High latency to local gateway ({ms}ms). Potential home network congestion.
panel.diag_wifi_weak_unstable: Weak Wi-Fi signal ({signal}%) causing packet drops.

show_text_in_bar.label: Show Ping Text in Bar
show_text_in_bar.description: When disabled, displays only a clean dynamic icon glyph with no text cluttering the bar.

idle_poll_interval_sec.label: Idle Polling Interval (seconds)
idle_poll_interval_sec.description: Background probe interval when the panel is closed. Conserves battery and CPU budget.

active_poll_interval_sec.label: Active Polling Interval (seconds)
active_poll_interval_sec.description: Fast probe interval while the HUD panel is actively open.

default_target_preset.label: Default Target Region
default_target_preset.description: Preconfigured game server cluster endpoint for latency and jitter diagnostics.

custom_target_host.label: Custom Target Host
custom_target_host.description: IP or domain name to probe when the Custom preset is active.

enable_loss_desktop_notification.label: Desktop Alerts on Packet Loss
enable_loss_desktop_notification.description: Notify when packet loss exceeds the threshold.

packet_loss_alert_threshold.label: Packet Loss Alert Threshold (%)
packet_loss_alert_threshold.description: Percentage of dropped packets within window that triggers a desktop notification.
